topic: Fernando PCSS similar-triangle blocker-ratio contact-hardening penumbra vs naive fixed-radius PCF rig
topic_zh: Fernando PCSS 相似三角形遮挡比接触硬化软阴影对比朴素定半径 PCF 近处糊成团与远处硬如刀
scope: Deterministic Randima Fernando (SIGGRAPH 2005 NVIDIA PCSS) Thales similar-triangle blocker-ratio penumbra estimation (w_PCSS = W_light * (d_receiver - d_blocker) / d_blocker with W_light = 1.60 m, d_blocker = 4.00 m) versus naive fixed-radius PCF (w_PCF = 0.8000 m) and 64-ray extremal area-light tangent-cone tracing across 17 receiver depth stations (d_r in [4.00 m, 12.00 m]).

protocol.function: w_PCSS = W_light · (d_r − d_b) / d_b → Contact w(4m) = 0.0000m & Station-12 w(10m) = 2.4000m (vs Fixed PCF 0.8000m)

robustness.name: Sampled 17 receiver depth stations match physical contact-hardening penumbra growth without contact halos or far-field starvation

good_fit: Contact-hardening sun, streetlamp, and studio softbox shadows in UE5, Unity HDRP, Three.js, and architectural visualization
Keeping character feet and tire contact points razor-sharp (w=0.0000m at d_r=d_b) while smoothly widening foliage/roof shadows with distance
Pairing with Vogel Golden-Angle Disk Poisson Sampling (Round 59) and Gruen Sin-Theta Normal-Offset Shadow Bias (Round 87)
Computing per-pixel penumbra filter radius in 3 algebraic operations from average blocker depth d_b
not_for: Infinitely distant zero-diameter pinhole point lights where physical penumbra width is identically zero everywhere
Shadow maps lacking linear or reversed-Z depth readback for blocker search
Volumetric cloud self-shadowing (use Beer-Lambert Extinction Round 55 or SDF Cone Shadows Round 94)
Baked static lightmaps with offline path-traced irradiance
